title: The Knock
caption: Three sharp raps. Knuckles on glass. The kind of sound that meant trouble whether you were ready for it or not.

title: The Knock
caption: His hand rested on his belt near the radio. / Not the gun. / Not yet.

title: The Knock
caption: "You've got seventy-two hours to move the vehicle," he said. "After that, it gets towed. Impound fees start at three hundred."

title: The Knock
caption: "You a vet?" / "Yeah," I said.

title: The Knock
caption: Seventy-two hours. / Three days to figure out where to go.

title: The Man in the Gray Suit
caption: I reached for the keys. / They slipped through my fingers.

title: The Man in the Gray Suit
caption: The man staring back wasn't me.

title: The Man in the Gray Suit
caption: A black sedan pulled out of a space three rows over. Dark windows. I couldn't see the driver.

title: The Man in the Gray Suit
caption: The world went white. / Then black.

title: The Man in the Gray Suit
caption: "It's me," he said quietly. "He's ready."

title: Disgusting
caption: "You gonna be all day?" a voice shouted.

title: Disgusting
caption: "Disgusting," he muttered.

title: Disgusting
caption: The heat hit me like a fist.

title: Disgusting
caption: I pressed my forehead against the window. The glass was already hot. It burned. I didn't move.

title: Forty-Eight Tiles
caption: White ceiling tiles. / That's what I saw first.

title: Forty-Eight Tiles
caption: "This isn't optional. You're a danger to yourself." / "I'm leaving."

title: Forty-Eight Tiles
caption: For three seconds, our eyes met.

title: Forty-Eight Tiles
caption: The phone died before it could go to voicemail.

title: From a Fellow Vet
caption: An envelope. / White. Unmarked. Sitting on the passenger seat.

title: From a Fellow Vet
caption: "From a fellow vet. Pay it forward."

title: From a Fellow Vet
caption: Someone had been inside my car.

title: From a Fellow Vet
caption: I should've been grateful. / I wasn't. / I was scared.

title: From a Fellow Vet
caption: "It's done," he said. "First deposit made."

title: Emma
caption: I scrolled to her name. My thumb hovered over the call button.

title: Emma
caption: I didn't press it.

title: Emma
caption: And for the first time in eight months, I thought about calling Emma.

title: Emma
caption: That night, I slept in the McDonald's parking lot.

title: Bring It Back
caption: "Bring it back," he said.

title: Bring It Back
caption: CASH FOR GOLD. GUNS. JEWELRY. NO QUESTIONS.

title: Bring It Back
caption: "Guy came in last week. Asked if anyone had pawned a watch like this. Stainless steel. 1941. Scratched crystal."

title: Bring It Back
caption: 480-555-0147. / The same number.

title: Bring It Back
caption: Seventy-five dollars. / For seventy-three years of history.

title: Seven Hours
caption: I woke up outside the car.

title: Seven Hours
caption: "I met him. I think. Or maybe I dreamed it. I can't—I can't tell anymore. If you're listening to this... if I'm listening to this... don't trust—"

title: Seven Hours
caption: It was still warm. / Like someone had just put it there.

title: Seven Hours
caption: Threw the card as hard as I could.

title: Seven Hours
caption: Fear was good. / Fear meant the hook was setting.

title: VFW Post 720
caption: VETERAN NETWORKING EVENT / Saturday, February 15th — 6:00 PM / VFW Post 720

title: VFW Post 720
caption: That afternoon, my phone rang.

title: VFW Post 720
caption: The hall was loud.

title: VFW Post 720
caption: BOOM.

title: VFW Post 720
caption: The road. The Humvee. The flash of light.

title: VFW Post 720
caption: "Hey brother," a voice said. "You okay?"

title: Just Breathe
caption: "Take your time," he said. "You're safe. Just breathe."

title: Just Breathe
caption: He pulled me to my feet. Steady. Strong.

title: Just Breathe
caption: "You want to get out of here?" he asked. "There's a coffee shop down the street. Quieter. Easier to breathe."

title: Just Breathe
caption: He started walking toward the parking lot. / I followed.

title: Skull
caption: "Skull," he said.

title: Skull
caption: "One deployment, I had twelve sets," he said. "Guys started calling me Skull. Death's assistant. The tag collector. It stuck."

title: Skull
caption: 480-555-0147. / The same number.

title: Skull
caption: "If we're going to be friends, you should know—I remember the ones no one else does."

title: Coffee and Lies
caption: Postino. 3939 E Camelback Rd. 12:30. See you there.

title: Coffee and Lies
caption: What if he'd been watching me the whole time?

title: Coffee and Lies
caption: "Liar," he said. Gently.

title: Coffee and Lies
caption: "You're better off without them," he said. Simply.

title: Coffee and Lies
caption: I took the bills. / Hated myself for it.
